name: Lift3D
aliases: Lift3D: Synthesize 3D Training Data by Lifting 2D GAN to 3D Generative Radiance Field
definition: An inverted 2D-to-3D generation framework that synthesizes 3D training data by lifting a pretrained 2D GAN to a 3D generative radiance field, achieving high-resolution synthesis and accurate 3D annotations.
